Loch Raven Village Apartments in Towson, Maryland

 

Our inviting community here at Loch Raven Village Apartments offers studio, one, two, and three bedroom apartments for you to call home! For your comfort, every apartment is equipped with oversized bedrooms, ample closet space, and an open design! Select units have been renovated to include kitchens featuring stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and maple cabinets.

Loch Raven Village Apartments offers many community amenities to make sure you enjoy your time here with us! Stay active at our fitness center, spend time outdoors at our courtyard area with charcoal grills, or enjoy playing with your four-legged friend at our dog park. Our business center is available to all residents 24 hours a day! For your convenience, we proudly offer a laundry facility, on-site management and maintenance teams, and off-street parking. Want to find the right floorplan for you? Select a floorplan to take a walkthrough video tour or contact our friendly leasing staff to set up a personal tour today!

Pet Friendly Apartments in Towson, Maryland

Here at Loch Raven Village Apartments you’ll experience peaceful living with all the best in location and comfort. Nearby, you will find many great shopping and entertainment options, including Towson Town Center and Towson Place. Loch Raven Village Apartments is located near several area employers and schools, such as US Social Security Administration, Greater Baltimore Medical Center, Pleasant Plains Elementary School, Loch Raven Technical Academy, Loch Raven High School, Towson University, and Goucher College. You can access all areas of town with ease, as Loch Raven Village Apartments is located just minutes from Interstate 695.

Loch Raven Village Apartments welcomes both cats and dogs! Enjoy playing with your furry friend at our convenient on-site dog park. Want to find the perfect apartment for you? Select a floorplan to take a walkthrough video tour or request a personal tour and make Loch Raven Village Apartments your new home!
